report: CyberCareers BD v5.2 measured employer-source audit

initial_full_audit.follow_up_request_budget_per_source: Shared pool; variable by employer. Initial landing/alternate requests are outside this budget.
initial_full_audit.operation: coverage_round with incremental read-only outcomes; no live job store writes

targeted_rechecks.selection: 16 registry route updates, earlier HTML-robots classification cases, and NCC Bank/Prime Bank/Trust Bank
targeted_rechecks.operation: _check_employer with a separate 12-request follow-up budget for each source

method.classification: Latest observation for each employer is retained with its actual tested_at and phase. Generic failure reasons are derived from the recorded message using the repaired reason classifier; this is not another network probe.

state_meaning.ok: The bounded probe found a readable recruiting list, structured vacancy, or explicit no-openings message. This does not certify that every role on the website was fetched.
state_meaning.partial: A page was reachable but extraction, a listing, JavaScript rendering, or the bounded scan remained incomplete.
state_meaning.blocked-or-unavailable: No usable employer page was read; recorded network/robots/access reasons are retained.

limitations: This is a two-phase HTTP-only audit, not a new full all-source hourly collector run or a production health snapshot.

The first phase ran during implementation. Targeted rechecks cover the changed registry routes and affected HTML-robots cases; subsequent conservative incomplete-page checks have automated regression coverage but were not re-probed across all 151 employers.

System Chromium was detected but browser startup failed because this runtime prohibits the required socket operation. Managed Chromium download also failed with HTTP 403. Real JavaScript-rendered outcomes are unverified here.
Robots 5xx/network failures and access controls were respected. A published employer URL was not marked operational simply because it was entered in the registry.
No attempt was made to access LinkedIn private APIs or bypass login, CAPTCHA, robots restrictions, rate limits, or employer access controls.
Readable source status does not imply an available cybersecurity vacancy. Zero qualifying vacancies can be a valid result.
The 36 directory/restricted/index/link-only entries are configuration categories, separate from the measured employer HTTP failures.
Actual deployment reachability can differ; run collector.diagnose or the complete scheduled collector in the deployment environment to obtain current production results.
